daily_session_clock.note: D1 high/low/open must follow the MT5 broker day. BRT is used for the operational window and intraday phase research.

methodology.daily_direction: BULLISH if price > broker_daily_open; BEARISH if price < broker_daily_open; NEUTRAL otherwise
methodology.higher_timeframe_availability: Use only completed H1/M15 bars at each M5 decision timestamp in research.
methodology.important_caveat: The exploratory TEST segment has now been inspected repeatedly while developing z-score, episode and clock hypotheses. New promotions require frozen forward shadow data or nested/walk-forward confirmation.

bullish_continuation_070_090.condition: daily_direction == BULLISH and H1/M15/M5 aligned BUY
bullish_continuation_070_090.interpretation: Robust research evidence for BUY continuation in the upper D1 zone before the extreme-high chase region.

bearish_continuation_010_030.condition: daily_direction == BEARISH and H1/M15/M5 aligned SELL
bearish_continuation_010_030.interpretation: The lower-side continuation is not a mirror image of the bullish 0.70-0.90 edge. Remove the old SELL preference from runtime scoring.

extreme_high_buy_chase.interpretation: Strong anti-edge for chasing BUY at the D1 extreme high. Keep AVOID_CHASE_BUY as the rule candidate. The inverse SELL looked strong in the recent TEST but failed historical train/validation stability, so it is not promoted as a SELL rule.

extreme_low_sell_chase.interpretation: Chasing SELL at the D1 extreme low is an anti-edge. This supports avoiding SELL chase and motivates the separate mean-reversion family.

extreme_low_zscore_buy.condition: D1 EXTREME_LOW + H1 DOWN + M15 DOWN + M5 rolling z-score <= -2.0
extreme_low_zscore_buy.interpretation: A stable lower-extreme mean-reversion family exists across multiple z thresholds. Z=-2.0 is the best current research balance between quality and sample, not the largest headline PF.

post09_second_stress_cycle_buy.definition: Episode count resets at 09:00 BRT. Enter episode when M5 z-score <= -2.0; episode resets only after z-score > -1.5. Select exact post-09 episode #2 when D1 EXTREME_LOW + H1 DOWN + M15 DOWN.

session_boundary_check.interpretation: This is explicitly a post-09 session-cycle feature, not the second z-score episode of the full broker day.

post09_second_stress_cycle_buy.interpretation: Episode #2 adds sequence information beyond simple D1 depth or z-score intensity, but the sample is small. Keep shadow-only until forward confirmation.

market_clock_high_volatility.metric: M5 bar range relative to trailing intraday median
market_clock_high_volatility.interpretation: This is the strongest clock discovery so far: a reproducible high-volatility phase. It is descriptive context, not a directional BUY/SELL rule.

not_promoted_or_unstable_findings.extreme_high_zscore_sell: Recent TEST mean-reversion SELL is positive, but train/validation fail across z=1.5/2.0/2.5. Treat as regime-flip evidence, not a structural SELL rule.
not_promoted_or_unstable_findings.rejection_variants: Headline PF can be very large but sample collapses; keep experimental only.
not_promoted_or_unstable_findings.first_event_per_day_low_zscore: 120m remains positive in TRAIN and TEST but fails VALIDATION, showing clustered intraday events carry information and first-touch alone is not enough.
not_promoted_or_unstable_findings.night_20_continuation: Bootstrap confidence is mixed across splits; not promoted.
not_promoted_or_unstable_findings.night_22_continuation: TRAIN is negative while later splits are mixed; rejected as stable continuation.
not_promoted_or_unstable_findings.night_2335_continuation: Promising later-period continuation, but TRAIN CI crosses zero; keep exploratory.
not_promoted_or_unstable_findings.pre_morning_reversal_0620_0800: TRAIN and VALIDATION lean reversal, but TEST mean is approximately neutral and bootstrap probability is 49.63%; not stable.
not_promoted_or_unstable_findings.post_vol_reversal_1255_1345: Median is negative in all splits, but bootstrap mean CI crosses zero and confidence falls to 52.40% in TEST; descriptive hypothesis only.
not_promoted_or_unstable_findings.weekday_rule: Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday effects were not stable enough to become a standalone rule.
not_promoted_or_unstable_findings.opening_echo_direction: 20:00-01:00 -> 08:00-09:00 direction match is not consistently above 50% in TEST. Echo magnitude and directional efficiency may still be useful state features.

next_association_stage.goal: Associate statistically discovered intraday phases with real market opens, closes, overlaps, maintenance/reopen windows and DST-aware session calendars only after the statistical phase boundaries are frozen.

research_evidence.promotion_rule: No new hard runtime promotion from this checkpoint. Keep runtime WARNING_ONLY. Promote only after frozen forward shadow or nested/walk-forward confirmation, independent-day validation, costs/slippage review and no material sample collapse.
